description: Synthetic district identifier (1-160); repeated in each of seven years.
Study period 1-7, not a calendar date.
Treatment cohort: treated_year5, treated_year6, or never (as applicable). No Year 7 adoption cohort.
First treated year; 0 means never treated. Constant within district.
1 for a district eventually treated; 0 for never-treated districts.
1 from the district's first treated year onward; otherwise 0.
year minus treatment_start_year; missing (NA in CSV, . in Stata) for never-treated districts.
Observed synthetic achievement on a common reference-SD scale. Untreated Years 1-4 pooled across districts define the reference mean and SD; observed outcomes are not restandardized after treatment.
Same outcome in synthetic score points: 50 + 10 * outcome_std. Continuous, unbounded; not a real test scale or a 0-100 score.
